# The BrainGlobe Initiative

## BrainGlobe Initiative {.smaller}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}
Established 2020 with three aims:

:::{.incremental}
1. Develop general-purpose tools to help others build interoperable software for computational neuroanatomy.
2. Develop specialist software for specific analysis and visualisation needs.
3. Reduce barriers of entry, and facilitate the building of an ecosystem of computational neuroanatomy tools.
:::

# brainglobe-atlasapi V3

## BrainGlobe atlases {.smaller}

Atlases in BrainGlobe are made up of 4 main components:

::: {.incremental}
1. Common coordinate space - text based metadata describing the coordinate system
2. Template - intensity based image of the brain
3. Annotations - per-voxel annotation and meshes for each region
4. Terminology - text based metadata linking annotations to names and parent-child relationships
:::

## brainglobe-atlasapi V2

::: {.incremental}
- Images stored as `.tiff` files
- Meshes stored as `.obj` files
- Distributed as a single `.tar.gz` file using [GIN](https://gin.g-node.org/)
- No reuse of data between atlases
:::

![](img/brainglobe-atlasapi_v3_structure_small.png){.fragment .absolute .nostretch width="75%" left="12.5%" top="55%"}

::: {style="background: #ffffffff; width: 47%; height: 10%; margin: 0px; position: absolute; top: 83%; left: 0%"}
:::

## brainglobe-atlasapi V3

::: {.incremental}
- Aligning with [Atlas Asset Organization](https://atlas-assets.readthedocs.io/en/latest/) spec
  - Images stored as OME-Zarr files
  - Meshes stored in the neuroglancer precomputed format
- Each component is downloaded as needed from [Amazon S3](https://open.quiltdata.com/b/brainglobe/tree/atlas/)
- Data is reused between atlases
:::

## brainglobe-atlasapi V3

![](img/brainglobe-atlasapi_v3_structure.png){.absolute .nostretch width="70%" left="15%" top="13%"}

## Using brainglobe-atlasapi {.smaller}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: false

from brainglobe_atlasapi import BrainGlobeAtlas

atlas = BrainGlobeAtlas("allen_mouse_25um")
```

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| output: true

from brainglobe_atlasapi import BrainGlobeAtlas

atlas = BrainGlobeAtlas("allen_mouse_25um")

print(atlas)
```


## Using brainglobe-atlasapi

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| output: true

template = atlas.template
annotations = atlas.annotation

print(f"Template type: {type(template)}, shape: {template.shape}")
print(f"Annotation type: {type(annotations)}, shape: {annotations.shape}")
```

## Using brainglobe-atlasapi

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| output: true

root_mesh = atlas.root_mesh()
hip_mesh = atlas.mesh_from_structure("HIP")
root_mask = atlas.get_structure_mask("root")

voxel_scale = (atlas.resolution[0] * atlas.resolution[1] * atlas.resolution[2]) / 1e9

print(root_mask.shape, root_mask.sum() * voxel_scale, "mm cubed")
```

## Easier queries of atlas metadata

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
from time import time

from brainglobe_atlasapi import BrainGlobeAtlas
from brainglobe_atlasapi.list_atlases import get_all_atlases_lastversions

start_time = time()

atlases = get_all_atlases_lastversions()
resolutions = []
species = []

for atlas in atlases:
    if atlas in ["australian_mouse_15um", "azba_zfish_4um", "hoops_tawny_dragon_50um"]:
        continue
    atlas = BrainGlobeAtlas(atlas, check_latest=False)
    resolutions.append(atlas.resolution[0])
    species.append(atlas.metadata["species"])

end_time = time()
```

```{python}
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker

sns.set_context("talk")
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")
# Create a DataFrame from the resolutions and species lists
import pandas as pd
df = pd.DataFrame({"Resolution": resolutions, "Species": species})

# Create a swarmplot of resolutions by species, sorted by mean resolution
order = df.groupby("Species")["Resolution"].mean().sort_values(ascending=False).index
ax = sns.stripplot(x="Resolution", y="Species", data=df, order=order, dodge=True, color="#ee9040", edgecolor="black", linewidth=1, size=8)
ax.set_xlabel("AP Resolution (µm)")
ax.set_xscale("log")
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.ScalarFormatter())
```

::: {.fragment}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: true
import subprocess

from brainglobe_atlasapi.config import get_brainglobe_dir

def get_dir_size(path):
    result = subprocess.run(['du', '-sh', path], capture_output=True, text=True)
    return result.stdout.split()[0]

dir_size = get_dir_size(str(get_brainglobe_dir() / "brainglobe-atlasapi"))

print(f"Time taken to load all atlases: {end_time - start_time:.2f} seconds")
print(f"Total disk space used: {dir_size}")
```

:::

## Using external S3 remotes {.smaller}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: false

from brainglobe_atlasapi import BrainGlobeAtlas

atlas = BrainGlobeAtlas("hmba-adult-cynomolgusmacaque-homba-atlas", remote_root="s3://allen-atlas-assets")
atlas.annotation
atlas.template
```

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| output: true
from brainglobe_atlasapi import BrainGlobeAtlas

atlas = BrainGlobeAtlas("hmba-adult-cynomolgusmacaque-homba-atlas", remote_root="s3://allen-atlas-assets")

print(atlas)
```

## Using external S3 remotes {.smaller}

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| output: true
#| output-location: slide
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

from brainglobe_atlasapi import BrainGlobeAtlas

atlas = BrainGlobeAtlas("hmba-adult-cynomolgusmacaque-homba-atlas", remote_root="s3://allen-atlas-assets")

plane = 280

annotation_slice = np.ma.masked_equal(atlas.annotation[plane], 0)

plt.imshow(atlas.template[plane], cmap="gray")
plt.imshow(annotation_slice, cmap="tab10", alpha=0.6)
plt.axis("off")
plt.show()
```
